tools.name: you.factory_session.control
tools.description: Apply one durable Factory Session lifecycle control such as approve, pause, resume, cancel, terminate, or retry-dispatch. Maps to POST /factory-sessions/{session_id}/{control}.

approvalPreviewId.description: Approval preview identity when operation is APPROVE.

approvedPolicy.description: Approved orchestrator policy when operation is APPROVE.

dispatchId.description: Target dispatch identifier when operation is RETRY_DISPATCH.

operation.description: Lifecycle control operation for one Factory Session.

reason.description: Optional operator-provided reason for audit and diagnostics.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key for one lifecycle control request.

tools.name: you.factory_session.get
tools.description: Get one durable Factory Session inspection read model with lifecycle status, source identity, phase, progress, and result summary. Maps to GET /factory-sessions/{session_id}.

tools.name: you.factory_session.get_result
tools.description: Retrieve one durable Factory Session result in final or partial mode with optional artifact metadata. Maps to GET /factory-sessions/{session_id}/results.

includeArtifacts.description: When true, include FactoryArtifact metadata refs in the response.

mode.description: Result retrieval mode. Defaults to final when omitted.

tools.name: you.factory_session.list
tools.description: List Factory Sessions for one scope (live workspace, persisted durable execution, or all). Uses GET /factory-sessions durable listing vocabulary.

scope.description: Session list scope. Defaults to live when omitted.

tools.name: you.factory_session.list_artifacts
tools.description: List FactoryArtifact summaries for one Factory Session, including artifact id, kind, visibility, size or hash metadata, and dispatch linkage when available. Maps to GET /factory-sessions/{session_id}/artifacts.

tools.name: you.factory_session.list_dispatches
tools.description: List dispatch summaries for one Factory Session, including dispatch id, status, kind, phase, and provider-session correlation metadata when available. Maps to GET /factory-sessions/{session_id}/dispatches.

tools.name: you.factory_session.read_events
tools.description: Read ordered Factory Session event facts for reconnect and inspection without exposing internal Petri-net terminology as the primary public vocabulary. Maps to GET /factory-sessions/{session_id}/events.

afterEventId.description: Reconnect cursor: return events after this FactoryEvent identifier.

afterSequence.description: Reconnect cursor: return events after this sessionSequence value.

tools.name: you.factory_session.start_async
tools.description: Start one async Factory Session and return an accepted or running summary for polling. Maps to POST /factory-sessions/async.

args.description: Structured Factory Session invocation arguments validated by the resolved source.

orchestrator.description: Optional orchestrator override when the resolved source does not fully determine orchestration.

requestId.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key for durable Factory Session start.

requestedPolicy.description: Caller-requested orchestrator policy before approval, if required.

factoryId.description: Factory id when kind is FACTORY_ID.

inlineWorkflow.description: Inline workflow payload when kind is INLINE_WORKFLOW.

workflowFile.description: Workflow file ref when kind is WORKFLOW_FILE.

workflowName.description: Workflow name when kind is WORKFLOW_NAME.

cancelOnTimeout.description: Whether to cancel the session when sync wait times out.

tools.name: you.factory_session.start_sync
tools.description: Start one sync Factory Session and wait for terminal completion or timeout. Maps to POST /factory-sessions/sync.

args.description: Structured Factory Session invocation arguments validated by the resolved source.

orchestrator.description: Optional orchestrator override when the resolved source does not fully determine orchestration.

requestId.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key for durable Factory Session start.

requestedPolicy.description: Caller-requested orchestrator policy before approval, if required.

factoryId.description: Factory id when kind is FACTORY_ID.

inlineWorkflow.description: Inline workflow payload when kind is INLINE_WORKFLOW.

workflowFile.description: Workflow file ref when kind is WORKFLOW_FILE.

workflowName.description: Workflow name when kind is WORKFLOW_NAME.

cancelOnTimeout.description: Whether to cancel the session when sync wait times out.

tools.name: you.factory_session.validate_source
tools.description: Validate JavaScript orchestrator factory source through the canonical Factory preview contract (POST /factories/preview) before starting a Factory Session.

allowFactoryLookup.description: When true, explicit factory lookup is attempted after ordered workflow lookup.

argsSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema object describing Factory Session invocation arguments.

artifactRoot.description: Optional absolute artifact root requested with the factory source.

defaultPolicy.description: Optional factory default policy layer merged into the effective policy preview.

inlineSource.description: Inline orchestrator source text for INLINE_WORKFLOW or FACTORY_INLINE requests.

metadata.description: Optional JavaScript orchestrator metadata to validate with the source.

projectRoot.description: Project root used for ordered JavaScript orchestrator source lookup.

requestedPolicy.description: Optional request policy overrides merged into the effective policy preview.

sourceKind.description: JavaScript orchestrator factory source request kind for Factory preview (POST /factories/preview).

sourceValue.description: Requested workflow name, file ref, factory id, or inline label.
